session.instructions:
An original young adult Japanese female voice around age twenty, speaking native standard Japanese. Sweet, sparkling, crystal-clear girlish high-mid register with light, nimble vocal weight and dewy, bell-like sweetness — distinctly cute, bright, and maidenly with natural smiling resonance. Clear forward projection, tender affectionate warmth, and crisp, lovely Japanese anime-heroine clarity.

Delivery direction: Sweet, bright, crystal-clear cute girlish voice with a warm, affectionate smile and lively clarity, spoken clearly at full close-mic conversational volume. No music or background noise. Project clearly into the microphone at strong, healthy studio loudness and stop cleanly after the sentence.
